     * and packet data.

     * But allow all normal voice/SMS/USSD/SS/AV64.

     * Only Emergency call allowed.

variables.name: RIL_RESTRICTED_STATE_CS_ALL
variables.comment:
* Block all voice/SMS/USSD/SS/AV64
     * including emergency call due to restriction.
